definitions.full: H6029. anad [ עָנַד ] verb bind around, upon (compare Arabic turn aside from way; Syriac defecit, defuit ; compare also עִמָּדִי (for עִמִּי )); — Qal Imperfect 1singular אֶעֶנְרֶנּוּ לִי Job 31:36 (object garland, in figure); Imperative suffix עָנְדֵם Prov 6:21 (figurative; || קָשַׁר ).
